files.RPL_nf5_vs_nf13_horizon_grid.mp4: Stacked grid: nf5 (top) above nf13 (bottom). Each grid: top row [+x, +y, nop], bottom row [-x, -y, nop].

interpretation: nf5 streams cleanly across 10 steps; nf13 visual quality degrades despite better single-step LPIPS. This shows the streaming-vs-clip quality gap that favors nf5 for teleop deployment.
